releases.name: v2.5.6
releases.body:
Removes the debug settings that were used while developing the mod: the ship log and dialogue tree dumps, along with the hotkeys to unlock all reels, reveal all events, unlock all achievements and reload dialogue.

The mod manager now shows a single option, *Carica eventi nel registro della nave*.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SbekuMod/Mod-V2/compare/v2.5.5...v2.5.6
releases.bodyZh:
移除开发模组时使用的调试设置：飞船日志和对话树转储，以及解锁所有卷轴、显示所有事件、解锁所有成就和重新加载对话的热键。

模组管理器现在显示一个选项，*Carica eventi nel registro della nave*。

**完整变更日志**: https://github.com/SbekuMod/Mod-V2/compare/v2.5.5...v2.5.6
